listen_address.description: IP addresses or hostnames to listen on. Use ['*'] for all interfaces, ['127.0.0.1'] for localhost only, or specific IPs.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for POP3 connections. Required for secure auth.

mail_processes.description: Maximum number of mail processes (workers) per user session.

mail_max_userip_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections allowed per user per IP address.

pop3_client_workarounds.description: List of POP3 client compatibility workarounds to enable. Common: outlook-no-nuls, oe-ns-eoh.

disable_plaintext_auth.description: Disallow plaintext authentication unless SSL/TLS is active. Recommended to keep enabled.

pop3_max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous POP3 server connections.

pop3_login_max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous POP3 login connections (connection-handling processes).

log_path.description: Path to the log file (e.g., '/var/log/dovecot.log'). Leave blank or use 'syslog' to log to the system log instead.
